name: second-brain-kit
description: Notes and a tracker of open work for Claude Code, set up by Claude (not an official Anthropic plugin). Basic: one main session in a numbered notes folder, the tracker Claude keeps (each item closed with evidence), a done-check that logs and safety hooks that ask before deleting or uploading. Claude suggests the Full parts (fixed entry, supervisor and maintenance sessions plus topic sessions, reminders, another-AI split by kind of work) one by one from where you get stuck, and you confirm; a weekly check offers more on pain signals, only with your yes. Sessions start only when you open them unless you choose auto-wake for your plan. Needs a Claude plan that includes Claude Code.
